summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing five Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns dated September 28 to October 2, 2026, disclosing on-market share repurchases made for cancellation. The filings itemize buybacks executed from early July through September 2026 at prices around USD 1.04-1.09 per share, each roughly 0.03-0.05% of issued shares. Outstanding shares stood at 244,789,786 as of September 24, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms are stated. Watch cancellation pace and any tender-offer or going-private follow-on.
